name: Poisoned Dart Statue

source.title: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

stealth.details: (expert) or DC 39 Perception check (master) to notice the control panel. Anyone specifically searching the name plate of Abresha Tallow-Hands locates the control panel automatically.

disable: DC 34 Thievery check (master) on the control panel deactivates the trap.
reset: The trap deactivates and resets after 1 minute.
routine: (1 action) The trap launches one dart against every creature in the hall as 1 action. Because it launches darts continuously, the trap can also use the Continuous Barrage free action (see below) to launch darts at each creature during that creature's turn. The trap doesn't take a multiple attack penalty.

items.name: Dart Volley
items.text:
Trigger A creature makes noise in the hall, which can be avoided with a successful DC 28 Stealth check check

---

Effect The trap makes a poisoned dart Strike against the triggering creature, then rolls initiative.

items.name: Continuous Barrage
items.text:
Trigger A creature within the hallway finishes an action while the trap is active

---

Effect The trap makes a poisoned dart Strike against the triggering creature.

items.name: Terinav Root Poison
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 28 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 4d6 poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)

Stage 2 5d6 poison damage, clumsy 2, and –5-foot status penalty to all Speeds (1 round)

Stage 3 7d6 poison damage, clumsy 2, and –10-foot status penalty to all Speeds (1 round)

text: Countless poison darts fire from holes in the statues and walls of this hall.
